content.title: Paired story response
content.summary: Participants post short story openings, receive two other openings, and write a continuation for one.
content.setup: Invite at least three participants and choose a source opening, source deadline, response deadline, and round ID.
content.participant: Post one opening before the source deadline. If enough openings arrive, request two others and continue one before the response deadline.
content.completion: At the response deadline, submitted sources and linked responses become visible to the group. Missing responses do not delay the reveal.
content.access: Participants need text entry and reading access. Saved offers may differ by request order; responses are revealed at the response deadline.

provenance.rights: Illustrative package content; reuse terms have not been specified.
